canonical_json.unicode: preserve scalar sequence; no normalization; reject surrogates
canonical_json.numbers: JSON integers only; no floats, NaN or Infinity
canonical_json.exact_rational: object with integer numerator and positive denominator, reduced by gcd
canonical_json.literal_words: arrays of menu letters, chronological source-to-destination order; no cancellation or sorting

exact_payload_shape.code: registered active code or null for completed
exact_payload_shape.context: exact typed data; no translated diagnostic text
exact_payload_shape.input_identities: expanded neutral key digest and candidate run-key digest, immutable input/model/menu/level/contract identities
exact_payload_shape.coverage: ordered examined set, total set, complete boolean; partial is never an absence claim
exact_payload_shape.budgets: units and granted/used steps, kernel_cost, memory peak, output; child ledger if present
exact_payload_shape.value: typed exact returned value or null
exact_payload_shape.words: all returned literal words, in output order
exact_payload_shape.certificates: exact included certificates; empty array when none
exact_payload_shape.checker_reports: exact reports and their input/checker identities; empty array when none
exact_payload_shape.traces: Ordered exact output/workspace/preview observations including host-built provenance; candidate source mapping is pinned separately; empty array when none
exact_payload_shape.stop: reason, run id, neutral instruction path and loop index or null; translated source span stays outside comparison

hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical JSON exact payload bytes, including value AND stop, coverage and all deterministic counters; compare within each full candidate/form key, never equate different keys.

display.rule: same shape and exact/non-numeric fields; compare each approximate coordinate to the frozen rational reference and pairwise across runs; reject nonfinite values; no tolerance on exact integers

meter.scope: Experiment-only counting fixture, not the LP1 metering decision or a proposed IR.
meter.steps: One charge before each executed instruction; each for-loop test (including final false test) costs one, its body instructions cost normally; if costs one plus executed body; call and return each cost one. Calc constituent charges follow notation.md: each scalar arithmetic/comparison or collection visit is a continuation, with integer limb weight. Flow-label bookkeeping is included in those logical charges, never an unmetered host instruction count. The four isolated budget probes use only tick/retain/emit/kernel.
meter.kernel_cost: Row table in fixture.json; precharge each logical call once; cache reconstruction, eviction and transport never add charges.
meter.memory: Inputs are pinned source bytes. A retain instruction creates a logical byte array of its declared size; each handle (including alias) counts in full to end of run. Snapshot retains 32 logical bytes (16 label bytes plus 16 fake exact pose-key bytes). Other bound values use canonical JSON byte length. Check before binding/growing; failed allocations do not increase used memory. Recursion uses a 16-byte logical frame per call in the recursion probe.
meter.output: Before emit/publish/capture/workspace output or a top-level return, charge canonical uncompressed JSON byte length of the emitted/returned value. A module return is internal and incurs no output charge. Terminal outcome uses a separate fixed 2048-byte reserved envelope; it cannot carry uncharged user output. Retained partial output remains charged.
meter.admission: Equal-to-limit is allowed; failed instruction step stays charged if its later resource check fails. Check order: interrupt at continuation, steps, kernel_cost, memory, output. A failed resource charge is not added to that counter.
meter.lifetime: Conservative retention until run end; no host GC or physical sharing changes charges.
meter.recursion: For the probe only, logical frames use memory allowance; no reserved recursion code is activated.
